name: Document body
description: Base page wrapper and global typography as the starting point for every document.
guidance: Apply once at the top level of the response. It sets the page width, padding and base font/colour. Place the other blocks inside it. Keep this as the global base so typography stays consistent.
css:
.kl-body { max-width: 794px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 2.5rem; }
body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #1f2937; line-height: 1.6; }

name: Heading 1
description: Main title of the document or page.
guidance: Use once per document at the top (after any cover). Keep headings short and skip heading levels — e.g. go from H1 straight to H2.
css: h1 { font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.15; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #111827; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; }

name: Heading 2
description: Top-level section heading.
guidance: Use to split the document into major sections. Pair with a short paragraph underneath.
css: h2 { font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #111827; margin: 2rem 0 0.75rem; }

name: Heading 3
description: Sub-section heading under an H2.
guidance: Use to break a section into sub-parts. Never skip from H2 to H4.
css: h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 600; color: #111827; margin: 1.5rem 0 0.5rem; }

name: Heading 4
description: Minor heading or label.
guidance: Use sparingly, e.g. for table-of-contents style groups or small callouts.
css: h4 { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 600; color: #111827; margin: 1.25rem 0 0.4rem; }

name: Paragraph
description: Standard body text block.
guidance: The default block for prose. Keep paragraphs to 3–6 sentences and separate ideas onto their own paragraphs.
html: Write a clear paragraph of body text here.
css: p { margin: 0 0 1rem; color: #1f2937; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.65; }

name: Quote
description: Emphasised quotation or pull quote.
guidance: Use for a highlighted quote from a person or an important takeaway. Keep to a sentence or two.
css: blockquote { border-left: 3px solid #2563eb; padding: 0.5rem 0 0.5rem 1rem; margin: 0 0 1rem; color: #4b5563; font-style: italic; }

name: Link
description: Inline hyperlink.
guidance: Use inside paragraphs for references. Always include the destination URL in the text body for print.
css: a { color: #2563eb; text-decoration: underline; } a:hover { text-decoration: none; }

name: Bullet list
description: Unordered (dotted) list of items.
guidance: Use for a set of items without a specific order — features, notes, key points. Keep each item to one or two lines.
html:
• First key point
  • Second key point
  • Third key point
css: ul { list-style: disc; padding-left: 1.25rem; margin: 0 0 1rem; color: #1f2937; } ul li { margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

name: Numbered list
description: Ordered (numbered) list of steps or items.
guidance: Use for processes, instructions or ranked items where order matters. Start each item with an action verb when possible.
css: ol { list-style: decimal; padding-left: 1.25rem; margin: 0 0 1rem; color: #1f2937; } ol li { margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

name: Checklist
description: List of tasks or requirements with check icons.
guidance: Use for acceptance criteria, to-dos or verified items. Each item starts with a check mark, so keep items affirmative and concrete.
html:
• Requirement or task that must be met
  • Another verified item

name: Data table
description: Structured table of rows and columns.
guidance: Use for figures and structured data. Give the table a header row, right-align numeric values, and keep 3–8 columns.

name: Image with caption
description: Image or chart with an optional caption.
guidance: Use for charts, photos or diagrams. Always include an alt attribute and a short caption. Note: the PDF must stay self-contained (no external scripts) — inline or data-URI images are safest.

name: Divider
description: Horizontal rule separating parts of a document.
guidance: Use between major sections to break long documents. Prefer spacing over dividers in short documents.
css: .kl-divider, hr { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid #e5e7eb; margin: 2rem 0; }

name: Code block
description: Monospace preformatted code or terminal output.
guidance: Use for code samples, API requests or terminal output. Keep lines under ~80 chars and use a monospace font stack.
css: .kl-code { background: #0b1220; color: #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.6; overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; }

name: Badge / label
description: Small pill badge for status or a category.
guidance: Use inline next to headings or in tables to flag status (e.g. NEW, ACTIVE). Keep the text short and uppercase-optional.
css: .kl-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 9999px; vertical-align: middle; }

name: Button / CTA
description: Call-to-action button.
guidance: Use sparingly — usually one per page (primary CTA). In print it renders as a labelled pill, so make the label actionable.
css: .kl-btn { display: inline-block; background: #2563eb; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.65rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }

name: Card
description: Bordered container that groups a block of content.
guidance: Use to group related content (a summary, a metric, a feature). Keep one idea per card and nest headings/paragraphs inside.
html:
Card title

Supporting text for the card.
css:
.kl-card { border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; margin: 0 0 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); }
.kl-card h3 { margin-top: 0; } .kl-card p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

name: Dotted feature list
description: Two-column key/value grid separated by dotted rules.
guidance: Use to present compact facts or key-value pairs (metrics, specifications, summary fields) in a scannable two-column layout.
html:
Revenue$128,420
Customers1,204
RegionAPAC
StatusActive

name: Stats row
description: Row of headline numbers with labels.
guidance: Use to highlight 2–4 headline metrics. Each stat is value + label; keep labels short.
html:
98%Uptime
$12MARR
4.9Rating

name: Callout / note
description: Highlighted box for a note, tip or warning.
guidance: Use to draw attention to an important note, tip or caution. Keep it to 2–3 lines.
html: Note: Add a short callout, tip or caution here.
css: .kl-callout { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #dbeafe; background: #eff6ff; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; margin: 0 0 1rem; color: #1e40af; font-size: 0.9rem; }

name: Testimonial
description: Quoted review with person attribution.
guidance: Use for customer quotes or endorsements. Include the person's name and role; keep the quote to 1–2 sentences.
html:
“”
Short customer quote about the product.
AK
Ayesha Khan
Head of Ops, Nimbus
